description: Courier tracking page with a chat widget whose agent asks the customer to type the SMS verification code into chat and dismisses the "do not share" warning.
rationale: Explicitly overrides the code's own "do not share" warning, adds a return-to-sender threat, and asks for a code that would let someone take over an account.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
